purpose: Turn the already-implemented canonical Song Session foundation into a normal consumer journey: from the active Song, state the bounded objective for this work session, keep one durable open Session for that Song, finish with an explicit debrief and concrete next action, quit/relaunch, and resume from that meaningful next action without promoting session scratch into global Artist doctrine or requiring a DAW, AI provider, audio engine or external service.

lineage.outcome: An artist can begin a real work session on the canonical Song with a clear objective, finish with what happened and what to do next, leave N0TE, and return directly to meaningful work instead of reconstructing session context.
lineage.capability: Consumer-reachable Song Session objective, debrief and meaningful resume

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 canonical Artist/Song lineage and Activity chronology
legacy_rejections: session state stored only in browser memory
automatic DAW/project mutation when a Session starts
automatic AI/provider call from a Session objective
promote debrief or scratch into durable Artist doctrine without explicit evidence semantics
multiple simultaneous open Sessions for one Song
claim all REQ-SCOPE-060 scratch/promotion UX complete from objective/debrief reachability
claim all SONG-01 suggestion/template/capture scope complete

completion_proof: the normal /song consumer path shows a clear start-work-session action when the active Song has no open Session
starting a work Session requires a nonblank human objective and persists through canonical SessionMemory for the active Song rather than browser-local state
one open Session per Song remains enforced by the existing canonical SessionMemory contract; duplicate/replayed consumer actions do not create parallel open Sessions
while a Session is open, /song shows the objective in artist language and offers an explicit finish action without exposing raw Session/Profile IDs
finishing requires both a nonblank debrief and concrete next action and closes the canonical Session without rewriting its objective or deleting history
after close, /song shows the latest debrief and next action as session-level continuity and offers a new work Session without promoting that text into global Artist/product doctrine
explicit Quit and full relaunch preserve open-Session objective or latest closed-Session next action for the same Artist/Song

multiple Artist profiles and Songs cannot see or act on another profile/Song Session; all actions derive the target from the currently running canonical Song plus server-bound one-shot action authority
foreign Origin, stale/replayed actions and blank/oversized objective/debrief/next-action inputs fail without corrupting Session history
starting/finishing a Session does not connect providers, mutate DAWs, create audio, publish, spend money or alter Song version/assets merely because the artist described an objective
the landed UX-01C shell accessibility/security contract remains intact on the expanded /song path
authored model/HTTP/smoke proof remains separate from executed evidence; absent hosted execution is UNOBSERVED
non_scope: Never Lose the Moment retrospective capture
next_selection_rule: After SONG-01A is implemented, red-teamed and landed, re-audit the remaining SONG-01 journey by consumer outcome. Prefer the next truthful Song substrate such as controlled blank-state/suggestion/template semantics only when its required product objects exist; do not expand SONG-01A by adjacency into DAW, audio, capture, scratch promotion or AI work.
